comment: Dispatch surface of the specialized SM90 decode-M dense fp8 block-scale GEMM, behind fp8_blockscale_gemm_sm90's 'specialized' backend. 'backends' lists the backend strings; the op entry carries the auto-routing keys (the compiled-in guards in flashinfer/gemm/fp8bs_decodem_sm90.py stay authoritative). backend='auto' routes to the specialized kernel only when this file is present and well-formed; FLASHINFER_SPECIALIZED_KERNEL_DISABLE=1 forces the stock route regardless of this file.

fp8_blockscale_gemm_sm90.form: BF16 activations (internal fused 1x128 per-token-group quantization, amax/448, eps 1e-4), FP8 e4m3 weights (N, K), float32 128x128 block scale grid (ceil(N/128), K/128), BF16 output
fp8_blockscale_gemm_sm90.band_note: the measured decode-M envelope (captured serve rows M in {1,2,4,8,12,16,24}); interior points admitted by band interpolation; larger M stays on the stock route
